description: Labeled evaluation set for the Contract Risk Reviewer. Each item is a contract snippet with the set of risk categories a reviewer should flag (ground truth). Includes positives (varied phrasing), HARD NEGATIVES (clauses that look risky lexically but are standard/benign and must NOT be flagged), and clean clauses. run_eval.py measures detection rate (recall), precision, per-category recall, and clean/hard-negative false-positive rate.
